title: Cross-referencing Western Australia's vegetation associations to the IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology: 90m Best-Candidate Spatial Synthesis
description:
This dataset provides a 90 m spatial synthesis and tabular lookup cross-referencing Western Australia's vegetation associations from a statewide vegetation map (DPIRD 006; 1564 vegetation associations across Western Australia) to Level 3 Ecosystem Functional Groups (EFGs) of the IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology (IUCN GET).

Cross-referencing relationships were established by 2 domain experts across 3 rounds of structured expert elicitation using fuzzy membership values. This package provides the synthesised best-candidate ('winner-takes-all') spatial layers from Round 3 (1564 eligible vegetation associations units mapped to 23 IUCN GET Ecosystem Functional Groups, along with pixel-level membership proportions, number of supporting interpreters, tabular cross-reference tables, and GIS styling files.

Attribution requirement: Spatial layers are derived from pre-European vegetation mapping of Western Australia (DPIRD-006) from dataWA ©State of Western Australia, Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. (CC BY 4.0).
